# Title

> One-sentence summary of the outcome this issue delivers.

## Description

Provide a concise overview of the work item.

Answer the following:
- What problem are we solving?
- Why is this work required?
- What business or technical value does it provide?
- What is the expected outcome?

---

## Background / Context

Provide any relevant background information, assumptions, dependencies, or references that will help understand this work.

---

## Scope

Clearly define what is included in this work.

Examples:
- Implement ...
- Design ...
- Develop ...
- Evaluate ...
- Integrate ...
- Document ...

Also mention any items that are explicitly **out of scope** if applicable.

---

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Requirement 1 completed
- [ ] Requirement 2 completed
- [ ] Tests executed successfully
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Code reviewed (if applicable)

## Dependencies

List any prerequisites or dependent work items.

Examples:
- Depends on Feature #12
- Requires dataset preparation
- Requires AWS infrastructure
- Requires model download
